description: How many positive integers cannot be made with coprime denominations a and b. The count is (a-1)*(b-1)/2. For 2 and 5 it is 2. For 4 and 7 it is 9. A pair that is not coprime is rejected. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/coin-count
